meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, Database on Indian Economy (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Weekly reserves and daily rates are final on release. Investment flows, ECBs and LRS are revised in later Bulletins; external debt is provisional for a quarter, then partially revised.
meta.product: Turnover in the foreign exchange market, daily (DBIE report 694)
meta.coverage: Foreign exchange turnover every trading day since August 1998: merchant and inter-bank, spot, forward, swap and cancellations, purchases and sales
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 694, US$ million, trading days. The daily figures do not add up exactly to the monthly table (report 1347): RBI revises the monthly totals, so both are kept as published.
